text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! We just got another supporter 
for Project L'Arc!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, the members of 
Team L'Arc. The efforts and results of <chrname> 
and the others have truly reached the 
racing fans...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Alllright, tonight we're having a mini 
after-party! Leave it to me, I'll treat 
all of you to whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with Mei Satake and the Project 
L'Arc members, they celebrated the rise in 
expectations with great joy!
